Messages.Author: Rémi
Messages.Body:
Dear all,

Can you confirm that a Ready Assamite who has just send his contracted target to torpor may first burn 1 blood to unlock thanks Monster and then play Provision of Silsila to get full blood ?

Relevant Card Texts:
Monster:
Master: archetype.
Put this card on a ready vampire you control. Once each turn when combat involving this vampire ends and the opposing minion is not ready, this vampire may burn a blood to unlock. A vampire may have only one archetype.

Provision of Silsila:
Only usable after a combat involving this Banu Haqim and a minion with a contract. Only usable if this Banu Haqim has been chosen for that contract. Only usable if the opposing minion is not ready and this Banu Haqim is ready. Usable by a locked vampire.
This Banu Haqim gains enough blood to reach full capacity. Burn the contract if it is still in play.

Thanks in advance,
Rémi.

Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body:
> Rémi wrote:
> Dear all,
>
> Can you confirm that a Ready Assamite who has just send his contracted target to torpor may first burn 1 blood to unlock thanks Monster and then play Provision of Silsila to get full blood ?
>
This is correct, Monster is used " [...] when [...] combat ends" which is before Provision of the Silsila that is used " [..] after a combat [...]". Both happen post combat and there is only a grammatical difference... alternatively, it could be said they happen at the same time which then would mean the effects are allowed to be ordered as you want.
